0022600198.text: The Timberwolves (7-3, 3rd in the Northwest and 0.5 games back, 6th in the West) host the Jazz (1-8, 5th in the Northwest and 6 games back, 15th in the West), with Minnesota riding a three-game winning streak and Utah on a seven-game losing streak. Minnesota is without Anthony Edwards (knee, surgery), Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles, surgery), Joan Beringer (fracture), and Terrence Shannon Jr. (hip bruise), while Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain). The teams have not met yet this season, but the Timberwolves won the 2025-26 series 3-1, including a 147-111 home win on 2026-03-18 in Minneapolis.
